full_judgment:
During the aforesaid revision of record of rights the lands appertaining to the aforesaid two CS Khatians were made fifty-three plots on cadastral survey and were recorded in the draft record of right bearing No. 1600, annexure 4 to the affidavit-in- opposition, in the name of said Rahmat Banu to the extent of eight annas' share and in the names of respondent Nos. 3 to 5, 7, 8, 10 to 16 and 18 to 21 and others to the extent of remaining eight annas share. This record-of-right was attested on 6.4.69. After the publication of this draft record-of right under rule 29 of the Tenancy Rules, 1955, ten objection cases were filed against it under Rule 30 of the said Tenancy rule on 22.2.71. Out of the said objection cases the objectors in objection case Nos. 377 of 1971 did not contest. The other nine objection cases were heard analogously and were allowed on contest against Rahmat Banu by the judgment and order dated 11.3.71 whereby the name of Rahmat Banu was struck off from the draft record-of-right. The certified copy of this judgment and order is at annexure '5' to the affidavit-in-opposition and against whereof the petitioner filed nine appeals being Nos. 34046 to 34054 of 1984 after eleven years eight months fourteen days claiming that the petitioner had purchased the interest of Rahmat Banu. These appeals filed obviously under rule 31 of the Tenancy Rules, 1955, were heard and disposed of analogously by Mr. Abu Abdullah, the Revenue Officer with the additional designation of Settlement Officer and by the judgment and order dated 16.8.84 he allowed the appeals and directed recording of the name of the petitioner as the sole tenant of the RS Khatian No. 1600. The copy of this judgment and order is' at annexure L to the writ petition. Subsequently, on the prayer of some of the respondents the Director of Land Records, Respondent No.1, directed the Settlement Officer to re-examine the aforesaid judgment and order passed in those nine appeals and accordingly the matter was considered by the respondent No. 1(a) Mr. Md. Shafayet Ali, Revenue Officer appointed with the additional designation of Settlement Officer and he by the impugned order dated 18.1.89 (which is at annexure 'O' to the supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner) exercising his power under rule 42 of the Tenancy Rules, 1955, cancelled the portion of the proceeding referred to in rule 31 relating to RS Khatian No. 1600 in question and directed that the proceeding shall be taken up fresh from the said stage of the hearing of those nine appeals. By the said order Mr. Shafayet Ali, made over those appeals to Mr. Kazi Nurur Rahman, Assistant Settlement Officer, for disposal. But as Mr. Kazi Nurur Rahman became ill Mr. Shafayet Ali withdrew the said appeals from the file of Mr. Kazi Nurur Rahman and transferred the same for disposal to the respondent No. 2. Abdul Kader Howlader, another Assistant Settlement Officer. Thereafter upon hearing the parties Mr. Abdul Kader Howlader dismissed all the said appeals by the analogous impugned judgment and order dated 5.2.89 as at annexure N to the writ petition and thereby restored the judgment and order dated 11.3.71 passed in the aforesaid nine objection cues and consequently the name of the petitioner was deleted from the RS Khatian No. 1600. 

 16. Rule 44 empowers Director of Land Records and Surveys to discharge all the aforesaid functions of a Revenue Officer as empowered under the aforesaid Rules including Rules 40 to 42.
